pages.text: $(italic)Pure melee investment. Best for Berserker, Vanguard, Samurai, Paladin.$(/italic)$(br2)All nodes are attribute-based — they apply immediately, no KubeJS required.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Melee Damage$(/bold) — Core trunk — increases base melee damage via Pufferfish's Attributes melee_damage attribute.$(br2)$(bold)Sword Mastery / Axe Mastery$(/bold) — Branch 1 / Branch 2 — exclusive choice. Sword branch adds crit chance; Axe branch adds armor shred.$(br2)$(bold)Attack Speed$(/bold) — Mid-trunk node. Increases attack speed attribute. Combines with Orc racial for extreme attack rate.
